scope: completed, independently audited source development readout; no target TTA

checkpoint.selection: first safe boundary after user review; no effect selection

metric_units: macro IoUs are fractions; deltas and CI endpoints are percentage points

metric_method.sIoU: Mean normalized xyxy IoU over all event_active && box_valid source frames; zero if no spatial support.
metric_method.vIoU: Sparse predictions are placed on a dense all-zero sampled-frame canvas; invalid geometry remains zero. Numerator sums box IoUs on support frames whose physical frame ID lies in predicted∩GT half-open event time; denominator counts sampled frame IDs in predicted∪GT physical time.
metric_method.tIoU: Continuous physical-time IoU of [frame_ids[pred_start], frame_ids[pred_end]+1) and [GT begin_fid, GT end_fid).
metric_method.format_failure: Retained in every denominator with vIoU=sIoU=tIoU=0; not silently dropped.
metric_method.no_spatial_support: The five unsupported queries remain in the 198-query and 31-parent metrics; they receive vIoU=0 and sIoU=0.
metric_method.paired_parent_bootstrap: Paired source-parent deltas; resample 31 parent deltas with replacement; 10,000 draws, NumPy default_rng seed 20260927, percentile 95% interval.
